NUTRITION
  energy:
    target_calories: 1800
    deficit_strategy: "300-400 kcal below maintenance; adjust -100 kcal if weekly average weight loss <0.3 kg for 2 weeks; add +100 kcal if energy low or fasting glucose <80 mg/dL consistently."
  protein:
    target_g_per_kg: 1.8
    distribution: "4 meals/day ~30-40 g protein each to blunt postprandial glucose and preserve lean mass."
    sources: "lean poultry, fish, eggs, Greek yogurt, cottage cheese, tofu, tempeh, legumes (pair with veggies), whey/isolate if tolerated."
  carbs:
    target_g_per_kg: 2.0
    timing: "Front-load around training and earlier in day; 25-35% of daily carbs in the post-workout meal within 2 hours."
    quality: "Low-GI, high-fiber: steel-cut oats, quinoa, berries, legumes, sweet potato, whole-grain pasta/rice; limit refined sugars/juices."
    fiber: "25-35 g/day from vegetables, legumes, whole grains; increase water as fiber increases."
  fats:
    target_g_per_kg: 0.8
    quality: "Emphasize mono- and omega-3 fats: olive oil, avocado, nuts, seeds, fatty fish 2-3x/week."
  meal_structure:
    pattern: "3 meals + 1 protein-forward snack."
    breakfast: "Protein + fiber + low-GI carbs (e.g., Greek yogurt, berries, chia; or veggie omelet + oats)."
    lunch: "Lean protein, big salad, 1-2 fists low-GI carbs."
    snack: "30 g protein smoothie or cottage cheese + veggies."
    dinner: "Protein + non-starchy veg + optional small carb if training late."
  glycaemia_considerations:
    metformin: "Maintain current dosing as prescribed; monitor for GI upset; avoid excessive alcohol."
    monitoring: "Check fasting glucose most mornings and 2 hours post-meal for new meals; note readings with meals and activity."
    hypo_prevention: "Though metformin rarely causes hypo, carry quick carbs; if <70 mg/dL, take 15 g fast carbs, recheck 15 min."
    hydration: "2-3 L/day water; include electrolytes if sweaty sessions."
    alcohol: "Max 1 drink/day, with food; avoid on training days if sleep or glucose worsens."
  peri_workout:
    pre_workout: "60-90 min pre: 25-40 g low-GI carbs + 25-30 g protein; 5-10 g fiber max."
    during: "Water; if sessions >75 min, add electrolytes; carbs generally not needed."
    post_workout: "Within 2 hours: 35-45 g carbs + 30-35 g protein; include colorful veg."
  weekly_examples:
    weekA:
      breakfast: "Veggie omelet + 40 g oats with cinnamon."
      lunch: "Grilled chicken, quinoa, leafy salad, olive oil."
      snack: "Greek yogurt 200 g + walnuts + blueberries."
      dinner: "Baked salmon, roasted broccoli, small sweet potato."
    weekB:
      breakfast: "Overnight oats (chia, cinnamon) + whey."
      lunch: "Turkey chili with beans + side salad."
      snack: "Cottage cheese + cucumber and cherry tomatoes."
      dinner: "Tofu stir-fry, mixed veggies, brown rice (small)."
  supplements:
    omega3: "EPA/DHA 1-2 g/day with meals (check with provider if on anticoagulants)."
    vitaminD: "1000-2000 IU/day if levels unknown; confirm with labs."
    magnesium: "Glycinate 200-300 mg at night if cramps/sleep issues."
    creatine: "3 g/day; supports strength and glycaemic control; monitor water intake."
  behavior:
    steps: "Aim 8000-10000/day; 10-15 min walk after main meals to improve postprandial glucose."
    sleep: "7-9 hours; consistent schedule."
    stress: "Daily 5-10 min breathing or mindfulness."
  adjustments:
    weight_plateau: "If 2+ weeks no change and adherence >85%, reduce carbs by 20-30 g/day or add 10 min to Zone 2 days."
    training_day_split: "On heavy lower-body or interval days, add ~20-30 g carbs to pre/post meals; on rest days, reduce carbs by ~20 g."
    glucose_flags: "If fasting >140 mg/dL for 3 days, review evening carbs and late snacks; add post-dinner walk; consult provider if persistent."
  safety_notes:
    foot_care: "Wear proper footwear; inspect feet daily; avoid barefoot training."
    bp_screen: "If hypertensive or dizzy, pause and check."
    rpe_autoregulation: "If glucose >250 mg/dL and ketones present or feeling unwell, skip intervals and do light walking; if <90 mg/dL and symptomatic, treat before training."
